import subprocess, time

def vncdo(cmd, timeout=15):
    full = r'"C:\cits\venv\Scripts\vncdo.exe" -s localhost::5900 -p cits2026 ' + cmd
    r = subprocess.run(full, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    print(f'vncdo({cmd[:30]}): rc={r.returncode} err={r.stderr[:80]}')
    return r.returncode == 0

def kabu_running():
    r = subprocess.run('tasklist /fi "IMAGENAME eq KabuS.exe" /fo csv /nh', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    return 'KabuS' in r.stdout

if kabu_running():
    print('KabuS already running!')
else:
    print('KabuS not running. Trying VNC Win+R...')
    # Win+R ダイアログ
    vncdo('key super-r', timeout=10)
    time.sleep(2)
    # KabuS.exe パスを入力
    path = r'C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\kabuStation\KabuS.exe'
    vncdo(f'type "{path}"', timeout=20)
    time.sleep(1)
    vncdo('key Return', timeout=10)
    print('Launched via VNC Win+R. Waiting 35s...')
    time.sleep(35)
    if kabu_running():
        print('SUCCESS: KabuS.exe is running!')
        time.sleep(10)
        r = subprocess.run('curl -s -X POST http://localhost:18080/kabusapi/token -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\\"APIPassword\\":\\"hiroki0380\\"}"', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
